description:
We are looking for Oracle PL/SQL Developer in Raleigh, NC for 7+ months contract position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job details mentioned below- 
 Title: Oracle PL/SQL Developer 
 Location: 301 N Wilmington St, Raleigh, NC 27601, USA 
 Duration: 7+ Months 
 Client: Direct Client 
 Mode of Interview: Inperson 
 
 

 

 Required Skills: 

• Solid developer - Oracle database development, code documentation and unit testing. PL/SQL development and SQL programming. Web development.
• Enhance the data model and write stored procedures. Report creation and validation.
• Strong support experience with ability to resolve application issues found during testing or in production.
• Integration design for data exchange, import and export. Familiar with ETL and FTP to include source, destination, schedule and job controls.
• Transitioning application maintenance/support to others including providing PL SQL training and support to technical staff.
• Researching/analyzing Functional requirements including Business Rule identification and validation, business documents and process improvements.

 Desired Skills: 

• Design application framework based on requirements documentation utilizing Oracle Database.
• “As Built” application analysis/design and system architecture documentation including database schemas and data retrieval methods.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
